# A splash: a centre column and a crown of six leaning spikes, 1.3 m tall, unlit cream. Origin at the
# water. The game grows and drops it (placeScaled).
new
material new Foam --base-color 1.0000 0.9255 0.8392 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.9255 0.8392
add mesh cylinder --name Col --vertices 6 --radius 0.16 --depth 1.3 --location 0 0 0.65
material assign Foam
add mesh cube --name S0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.12 0.12 0.7
apply --scale
set rotation 0 28 30
apply --rotation
set location 0.303 0.175 0.3
apply --location
material assign Foam
add mesh cube --name S1 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.12 0.12 0.7
apply --scale
set rotation 0 28 90
apply --rotation
set location 0.000 0.350 0.3
apply --location
material assign Foam
add mesh cube --name S2 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.12 0.12 0.7
apply --scale
set rotation 0 28 150
apply --rotation
set location -0.303 0.175 0.3
apply --location
material assign Foam
add mesh cube --name S3 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.12 0.12 0.7
apply --scale
set rotation 0 28 210
apply --rotation
set location -0.303 -0.175 0.3
apply --location
material assign Foam
add mesh cube --name S4 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.12 0.12 0.7
apply --scale
set rotation 0 28 270
apply --rotation
set location -0.000 -0.350 0.3
apply --location
material assign Foam
add mesh cube --name S5 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.12 0.12 0.7
apply --scale
set rotation 0 28 330
apply --rotation
set location 0.303 -0.175 0.3
apply --location
material assign Foam
select Col S0 S1 S2 S3 S4 S5
active Col
join
select all
shade flat
export splash.glb
